correctness.rationale: Reconstruction of the Petersen graph as KG(5,2) gives precisely 15 graph edges, 331 nonempty matching faces and 12,121 barycentric flags. The exact 120-element and 60-element group actions yield quotient f-vectors (10,32,47,30,6) and (14,58,94,60,12). Rank-separated barycentric flags guarantee no inversions or identified facets within cells. Every one of 62 and 100 claimed free-face collapses is checked against the complete current coface relation, with maximality. The remaining A5 two-complex has 8 vertices,18 edges,12 faces; contracting a 7-edge spanning tree yields 11 explicitly computed generators and 12 nonabelian attaching relators. Eleven generator/two-cell cancellations (one occurrence in a relator at every stage) leave one zero-cell and one constantly attached two-cell. This proves S5 quotient contractible and A5 quotient homotopy S2, not merely homological or sampled statements. Executable verify.py was replayed successfully.

value.rationale: S5=Aut(Petersen) and its index-two simple alternating subgroup A5 are the canonical comparison for symmetry-sensitive topology of this graph. Known rational homology detects one A5 class and none under S5, but leaves genuine fundamental group, integral torsion and attaching ambiguity. The new exact integral sphere/point homotopy distinction resolves that gap by constructive topological reductions and supplies a reproducible finite geometric model. It is a natural complete two-subgroup classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or trivial chain-rank increment; no infinite-family extension is claimed.
